description: MiniMax-M3 sparse-layer monokernel steps on a TP4 group: decode R=1, EAGLE3 verify of one request (R=1 x 4 rows) and of four requests (R=4 x 4 rows), the 1, 4 and 16-row builds. Contexts are the AgentX corpus (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126, all 98,827 requests) decode-step-weighted context quantiles clipped at MiniMax-M3's served context 131,072: p10 52K, p25 108K; 53 % of AgentX requests (about 70 % of decode steps) are past 131,072 and cannot be served by this model, so the cap is the dominant perf context. Derived from corpus statistics; not yet confirmed by a live capture. Boundary contexts (one key, inside the first block, exactly 16 blocks, the first scored context, a block-boundary verify, the first long context) are correctness-only.

cases.source: boundary: decode with a one-key context (minimum of every axis)
boundary: verify of a 34-37-key context, inside the first block
short context: AgentX request-weighted p5 (3.0K), decode R=1; 24 blocks, scored
boundary: verify at exactly 16 blocks, every block kept without indexer scores
boundary: 4 x 4 verify at the first scored context (17 blocks), the other requests ragged in [1024, 2049]
boundary: verify rows straddling a block boundary (32 and 33 blocks)
boundary: the first context past 512 blocks (the split-stage long selection)
AgentX low end (16K; 9.2 % of decode steps are at 4-64K), decode R=1

AgentX decode-step p25 (108K), EAGLE3 verify R=1 x L=4
